@sketch
Feature: Line

  @acceptance @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-01 Commit the intended result
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an empty editable planar sketch is active
    When the user select Line and click two distinct points
    Then one segment joins the points and the command offers a connected next segment
    When the user press Escape
    Then the command ends and the visible segment remains

  @documented_observation @edge_case @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-02 Inspect repeated-pointer input
    Given an editable sketch with the captured geometry is active
    When the user start Line and select a start point
    And the user click the same screen coordinate again
    Then the dynamic length display shows approximately 0.678 mm
    When the user select a distinct endpoint and exit Line
    Then the longer connected segment remains visible

  @cancel @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-03 Cancel after only a start point
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user select Line and choose a start point
    And press Escape before an endpoint
    Then the dynamic input closes and Ready returns
    And no new segment is visible at the canceled location

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: line-04 Undo and redo the recorded numeric creation
    Given the recorded length-10 and angle-30 segment has been accepted and Line exited
    When the user undo its creation
    Then its numeric annotations disappear
    When the user redo creation
    Then the numeric annotations return
    When the user open Measure and select the segment
    Then Measure reports its length as 10.000 mm

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @repeatability
  Scenario: line-05 Continue endpoint selection after accepting a segment
    Given Line is active and a start point has been selected
    When the user select a distinct endpoint
    Then Line offers the next connected segment from that endpoint
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns and the accepted segment remains

  @documented_observation @input_mode_comparison @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-17 Compare recorded endpoint gestures with Precise Input open and closed
    Given a horizontal source segment in an editable YZ sketch
    And Line is active at its endpoint with Precise Input open
    When the user drag from the endpoint and release
    Then the pending preview remains straight
    When the user open the Line context menu and press Escape
    Then the menu closes while Line and the pending straight preview remain active
    When the user press Escape again
    Then Line ends and the horizontal source remains
    When the user restart Line and close Precise Input through its toolbar options
    And the user acquire the source endpoint and drag from it, then release
    Then the pending preview remains straight
    When the user press Escape
    Then only the accepted horizontal source remains

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @numeric_angle_history
  Scenario: line-18 Measure the numeric line angle before and after creation history
    Given the recorded YZ sketch fixture contains an isolated horizontal reference curve
    When the user start Line and choose a start point
    And the user enter length 10 and angle 30 in separate dynamic fields and accept
    And the user exit Line and open Measure
    And the user select the new curve and the horizontal reference
    Then Measure reports the new curve length as 10.000 mm
    And the reference length is 13.544 mm
    And the angle between them is 60.00 degrees
    And the minimum and maximum distances are 9.664 mm and 21.681 mm
    When the user close Measure, undo and redo creation
    And the user open Measure and select both curves again
    Then the lengths, angle and distances have the same displayed values

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @saved_fixture
  Scenario: line-19 Reopen the saved numeric line fixture
    Given the recorded YZ sketch fixture contains the numeric line and horizontal reference
    When Finish Sketch settles and the part document is saved, closed, and reopened
    And the saved sketch is edited and the two curves are selected in Measure
    Then the numeric curve measures 10.000 mm and the reference measures 13.544 mm
    And their angle is 60.00 degrees and minimum distance is 9.664 mm
    And the maximum distance is 21.681 mm with minimum delta X 0.000 Y 8.270 Z 5.000 mm

  @close @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-20 Close a two-segment chain and inspect loop recognition
    Given two connected straight segments in the recorded triangle fixture have been accepted with Line still active
    When the user open the active context menu and choose enabled Close
    Then a third edge connects the current end to the first point
    And Line returns to start-point selection
    When the user leave Line and select the triangle interior in Region Properties
    Then Sketch Loop1 is accepted and Calculate reports area 8.113 square millimetres

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @restart
  Scenario: line-21 Restart without removing an accepted segment
    Given the separate one-segment chain is accepted and the next segment is pending
    When the user open the active menu
    Then Restart is enabled and Close is disabled
    When the user choose Restart
    Then the pending preview disappears and the accepted segment remains
    And Line requests a new start point

  @documented_observation @double_click @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-22 End connected creation with endpoint double-click
    Given Line has a newly chosen start point
    When the user double-click the intended endpoint as one uninterrupted gesture
    Then the straight segment is accepted and Line requests a new start
    When the user exit Line then undo once
    Then only that last segment disappears
    When the user redo
    Then the segment returns

  @active_history @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-23 Compare the recorded active and Ready Undo results
    Given two connected segments have been accepted
    And Line is active with its dynamic length field selected
    When the user press Ctrl+Z
    Then both accepted segments remain visible and Line remains active
    When the user move the pointer to display a nonzero pending segment and press Ctrl+Z again
    Then the accepted segments and pending preview remain visible
    When the user terminate Line through marking-menu OK and press Ctrl+Z at Ready
    Then the second accepted segment disappears
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then the second segment returns

  @documented_observation @marking_ok @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-24 Finish Line with OK without accepting the pending third preview
    Given Line is active with two accepted connected segments and a pending third preview
    When the user choose OK in the marking menu
    Then Line ends and Ready returns
    And the two accepted segments remain
    And the pending third preview is discarded

  @chain_persistence @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-25 Reopen the accumulated Line chain fixture
    Given the retained Line groups after Ready-state Redo show 20 dimensions needed
    When the user finish the sketch and save the part document
    And close its document tab then reopen the part document and edit the saved sketch
    Then the upper-left two-edge chain and original source are visible
    And the 10 and 30.00 annotations, triangle, separate horizontal segment and oblique segment remain
    And Ready shows 20 dimensions needed in RIGHT view

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-27 Measure the newly retained arc without attributing its creation input
    Given an editable sketch contains a retained arc and shows 28 dimensions needed
    When its Curve is selected in Measure
    Then radius is 2.580 mm and diameter is 5.160 mm
    And length is 4.200 mm and sweep is 93.27 degrees
    And its center is X 0.000 Y 1.203 Z 38.923 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-28 Inspect retained arc history and numerical restoration
    Given the retained source line, arc and following line
    When the user press Undo once
    Then constraint glyphs disappear while geometry and the 28-dimension count remain
    When the user press Undo again
    Then the following line disappears and the count becomes 26
    When the user press Undo once more
    Then the arc disappears and the count becomes 24
    When both creations are redone
    Then the count returns to 28 and all displayed arc measurements match
    And the history lists Create Line, Create Tangent Arc, Create Line latest first

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-29 Reopen the saved retained arc fixture
    Given the measured arc fixture is finished and saved
    When the part is closed, reopened and its sketch edited in the same session
    Then the chain remains with 28 dimensions needed
    And arc radius, diameter, length, sweep and center match the baseline

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: line-30 Compare endpoint dragging with HUD disabled and restore preferences
    Given Sketch HUD is enabled
    When HUD is temporarily disabled and Line acquires the original source endpoint
    And a drag from 1232,355 to 1400,500 is released
    Then a straight pending preview remains with length 10.271 mm and angle 229.88 degrees
    When Escape cancels the preview
    Then the retained fixture remains at 28 dimensions needed
    When HUD is restored and Application Options reopened
    Then HUD is checked again

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: line-07 Inspect both history operations after a repeated-coordinate attempt
    Given the recorded sketch fixture is active after the Line start point was clicked twice at the same screen coordinate
    And a distinct endpoint was then selected
    When the user exit creation and dismiss the transient point selector
    Then the status reports Ready and 220 dimensions needed
    When the user press Undo twice, observing the state after each key press
    Then the reported counts are 218 and 215 respectively
    When the user press Redo twice, observing the state after each key press
    Then the reported counts are 218 and 220 respectively
    And the longer upper segment returns

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @numeric_input @undo_redo
  Scenario: line-08 Create a line using separate length and angle HUD fields
    Given the recorded numeric-input sketch fixture is Ready
    When the user select Line and choose a start point
    And the user enter 10 in the length field
    And the user press Tab to lock length and select angle
    And the user enter 30 in the angle field
    And the user press Return and then Escape
    Then the retained annotations show 10 and 30.00 degrees
    And the sketch is Ready
    When the user dismiss the transient selector and undo then redo the creation
    Then the numeric annotations disappear and return
    When the user measure the visible upper segment
    Then Measure identifies a Curve of length 10.000 mm

    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user start Line and choose a start point

    And the endpoint-selection prompt remains without a modal dialog
    And no accepted new segment is visible

  @needs_fixture

    When the user press Escape
